text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I conquered my debut race. My Trainer was 
utterly intoxicated by my dazzling 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That must be why she proposed running in 
graded races. However, following the "MC 
Rotation" demands true underlying 
strength. Far more than she currently 
possesses.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, they decided to aim for the 
Shinzan Kinen. The Junior class would 
serve as a period of maturation.
